name: Falei
desc:
Falei is a Ganymede NPC. He is one of the Apprentice Divers who joined [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract) in his expedition into the Second Layer before his betrayal.

He is located in the [Sanctuary Gatehouse](location:sanctuary_gatehouse) in [The Eternal Gale](location:second_layer). He gives tips about the strong gale winds in the layer.
